About the Fellowship

These Radboud postdoctoral positions develop synthetic cells for sustainable biomanufacturing. Research combines cell-free systems, high-throughput experiments and active learning to improve protein production and the design of synthetic cell components. The two vacancies are covered by one recruitment advert.

Research Areas

  • Synthetic cells
  • Biomanufacturing
  • Active learning

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPostdoctoral position
Stipend / salaryEUR 3,706–5,760 gross/month

Recruitment can close before the deadline once suitable candidates are appointed.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Academic preparationRelevant completed PhD and research preparation matching the synthetic cells project.
Further conditionsRelevant PhD; one advert offers two positions; counted once; may close early if filled.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen until filled
Deadline / consideration round15 October 2026
LocationNetherlands

About Radboud University

Radboud offers doctoral and postdoctoral research through its faculties and institutes in Nijmegen. Advertised research positions set out the scientific project, qualifications, employment terms and application route.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 15 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
